newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wafangdian to list B shares on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Wafangdian to list B shares on Tuesday.

text.p: China's Wafangdian Bearing Co Ltd 2706.SZ will list 130 million B shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on Tuesday, a company statement said on Friday.
The shares were issued early this month at HK$2.66 each, giving a price/earnings ratio of 7.9 times based on 1996 net profit on a fully diluted basis, the statement said.
Proceeds will be used to upgrade technology and expand production of the firm, which is China's biggest bearings manufacturer, the company's share issue prospectus said.
Swedish roller bearing manufacturer AB SKF has bought 65 million Wafangdian B shares, or 50 percent of the total issue, at HK$3.575 each, lead underwriter China Southern Securities Co has said.

The Swedish company bought the shares at a price 35 percent higher than the public offering price and promised to hold them for at least two years as a way into China's bearings market, a company spokesman said earlier.
Wafangdian said it forecast net profits of 129.33 million yuan in 1997, against an estimated 120 million for last year under international accounting standards.
Turnover was expected to be 1.37 billion yuan in 1997 compared with an estimated 1.22 billion yuan for 1996 and 1.07 billion yuan booked for 1995, it said.
The company has said it plans to boost profits by renovating production technology. It will invest 1.6 billion yuan in technological upgrades by the end of the century.
The company has a total of 330 million outstanding shares, made up of 200 million institutional shares and 130 million B shares.
The Swedish firm is the largest holder of B shares accounting for 19.7 percent of total outstanding shares, giving the Swedish company voting rights.

Wafangdian makes automobile, railway and petrochemical bearings in Wafangdian city in the northeastern province of Liaoning. It sells 90 percent of its products domestically and 10 percent to the United States, Southeast Asia and Africa.
